method: Re-checked against the official PDF with pdftotext -layout, -raw and -table, the official marking scheme, and page grids/crops of the recovered figures (scripts/recovery/page.py).

checks.reason: Options (a) and (b) are stored as 'Assertion (A) is true and Reason (R) is false.' / 'Assertion (A) is false and Reason (R) is true.' but the paper prints '(A) is true and (R) is false.' / '(A) is false and (R) is true.'; also only the group total [15] is printed for Question 1, so the stored 1 mark is a split with no marksNote.
The officialAnswer gives (d) as "A'B'C'D'E'F'G'H'I' (prime/image marks may not have survived extraction)", but the marking scheme prints (d) APONMLKJI.

The officialAnswer does not match the marking scheme: (a) drops 'In ΔADC', (b) writes 'triangles are similar, EF/AD = EC/DE' where the scheme has 'ΔADC~ΔFEC, EF/AD = EC/DC', and (c) writes (AF²−EF²) : EF² where the scheme has (AD²−EF²)/EF².
